blurb: Owned the company's first production Fivetran deployment, from connector framework design through pipeline health.

highlights.text: Architected a self-initiated Fivetran-to-Databricks pipeline with a self-service web app, enabling agentic Claude-driven tag automation on a scheduled routine.
Engineered a modular Fivetran connector framework in Python, consolidating per-source pipelines into a configurable system that cut onboarding and validation from days to hours.
Shipped 5+ production ingestion pipelines with pagination, authentication, incremental sync, and high-volume ingestion of 100K-1M+ records per source.
Added retry handling for transient failures (HTTP 500s, expired 403 tokens) and state management for sync resumption; served as primary point of contact for pipeline health.
Contributed to a DataHub lineage POC on Kubernetes, stress-testing connection and memory limits and fixing real OOM failures at the pod and container config level.

blurb: Led the computer vision workstream for a real-time railway signal classifier running on constrained edge hardware.

highlights.text: Engineered an edge-based ML inference solution using YOLOv8 to classify signals in real time on a Raspberry Pi 4.
Cut inference invocations roughly 60-70% by gating the model behind MAD frame-difference change detection.
Eliminated false flashing detections with a 4-batch majority vote and strict alternating-sequence confirmation, reaching near-zero false positives in field simulation.
Built a 6-stage image pipeline (crop, denoise, sharpen, white balance, gamma, CLAHE) with objects precomputed at import time to hold down per-frame latency.
